description:
`Road vehicle factory {GLO}`, a dataset AGRIBALYSE copied from ecoinvent, takes 16,722,321 m3 of `Gas, natural/m3` from the ground. The list publishes that row on EF 3.1's `Natural Gas`, measured in megajoules, and on the first five-list full build (2 September 2026, `944b274`) nothing on the mapping said how many megajoules a cubic metre is. 26 AGRIBALYSE rows were in that state: energy carriers by mass or volume onto megajoule flows, radionuclides by mass onto kilobecquerel flows, manganese-55 by activity onto the element, water released by mass onto cubic-metre flows.

Each now either carries its conversion on the mapping or is accepted with the reason no number exists. The numbers are AGRIBALYSE's own wherever it states one: the substance section at the end of `AGB32_final.CSV` gives each energy carrier a lower and a higher heating value, and the net one is used. Three of AGRIBALYSE's coal-mine off-gas rows were found to reach `Natural Gas` at all only because the vendor writes natural gas's registry number on them; with the number taken off, as #80 did for every other list, they reach the coal-mine off-gas flow ecoinvent's and BAFU's rows reach.

The population-wide claim -- no crossing left without a ruling -- is `0805-no-quantity-kind-crossing-is-unrecorded`. These name single rows, so that a later change reaching the same flows by another number fails here rather than passing the count.

expectations.title: AGRIBALYSE's natural gas in cubic metres converts at 34.5 MJ per cubic metre
expectations.comment: The issue's example row. 34.5 MJ/m3 is the lower heating value AGRIBALYSE's substance section gives `Gas, natural/m3`, and also what ecoinvent 3.8 -- the background AGRIBALYSE 3.2 is built on -- states for its own cubic-metre natural gas (#777). No factor before this change.

expectations.title: AGRIBALYSE's hard coal in the ground converts at 18.2 MJ/kg
expectations.comment: The vendor's net heating value, not the 18.01 ecoinvent's and BAFU's rows carry onto the same target; the choice is the user's on #370, and whether every list should convert by its own value is #407. Claimed so that a change back to one number per target has to rewrite this, with its reason.

expectations.title: `Gas, natural, 46.8 MJ per kg` converts at 46.8 MJ/kg
AGRIBALYSE's coal-mine off-gas in cubic metres reaches the coal-mine off-gas flow, at 1.0

expect.target_name: Gas, Mine, Off-gas, Process, Coal Mining

expectations.comment: Reached `Natural Gas` in MJ by natural gas's registry number before this change, in 2,182 datasets and at up to 447,520 m3 -- a different substance (#80) published in the wrong unit. 1.0 because it is ecoinvent 3.8's `m3` flow, which ecoinvent relabelled `Sm3` without changing its amounts.

expectations.title: AGRIBALYSE's coal-mine off-gas in kilograms reaches the coal-mine off-gas flow, at 1.254 cubic metres per kg

expect.target_name: Gas, Mine, Off-gas, Process, Coal Mining

expectations.comment: The ratio of AGRIBALYSE's two stated heating values for the gas, 44.9 MJ/kg over 35.8 MJ/m3.

expectations.title: AGRIBALYSE's `Radium-226/kg` converts at radium-226's specific activity
expectations.comment: 3.66e10 Bq per gram, the ChemLin value the list publishes on the substance, is the same number of kBq per kilogram.

expectations.title: AGRIBALYSE's water released by mass converts at 0.001 cubic metres per kg
expectations.comment: `Lemon, at farm {IT} U` releases 3,751,200 kg of this water, which was published as 3,751,200 cubic metres.
